mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
